subject: Procurement path & budget owners — Redwood trial / Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement path & budget owners — Redwood trial / Acme Corp

Alex / Acme procurement team — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and a couple of asks so we can get the trial and procurement path moving: 

Summary from call:
- Acme wants a 6-week technical trial to validate latency/cost on your customer-facing recommendation pipeline.
- Primary concern: data security and audit logs retention. You confirmed SOC2 + KMS requirement is necessary.
- Commercial preference: PO preferred but card acceptable for a smaller initial POC purchase.

Open asks / next steps for Acme procurement:
1) Can you confirm the official procurement contact and the budget owner who will sign off? (name, title, email)
2) Does Acme require a signed SOW or is a PO referencing our standard SOW sufficient?
3) Are you interested in transacting via cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace) or direct contract?

I've attached a short procurement checklist that outlines the typical paperwork we need on our side. If you can share your procurement timeline (typical internal approvals / signatory path), that helps us propose a matching commercial option (PO vs card, marketplace listing, or short-term pilot invoice).

Proposed Redwood next steps:
- I'll send a tailored procurement checklist + SOW stub.
- If PO path, we can route to our finance team and provide net-30 terms for pilot.
- If marketplace preferred, we can prioritize listing timelines — may add 1-2 weeks.

Thanks — available tomorrow 10-11am PT if you want a quick follow-up.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales (West)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet)]

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement path & budget owners — Redwood trial / Acme Corp

Thanks for the recap, Marissa — good notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Budget owner: Samantha Lee, Director of Finance (samantha.lee@acme-corp.com). She will sign off on pilot spend under $50k.
2) Signatory: For anything >$50k our CFO (Mark Reynolds) signs. Pilot should be under the $50k threshold if scoped carefully.
3) Process: Our procurement team prefers PO referencing a SOW. We can issue a PO once we have the SOW (standard template fine) + Red team security questionnaire filled out.
4) Marketplace: We evaluate marketplace purchases but for pilots we typically do direct PO to the vendor to speed things up. If Redwood is on AWS Marketplace and can provide immediate invoicing, we will consider it, but marketplace listing is not a hard requirement.

Timeline: procurement review + finance approval typically 5-10 business days for a pilot that falls under the $50k spend.

I'll loop Samantha here to confirm budget availability and timing — Samantha, can you confirm?

On the security side, procurement asked for SOC2 cert and an expected retention window for audit logs (we typically need 1 year).

Appreciate the checklist — we'll review and get back.

- Alex
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp

Vivek / Laura — forwarding thread with Acme. Quick internal notes: 
- Budget owner is Samantha Lee (Director of Finance). Pilot target = keep < $50k so Samantha can approve without CFO-sign-off.
- Preferred commercial path: PO referencing SOW. Marketplace optional but not required for pilot.
- Security ask: SOC2 Type II and 12-month audit log retention. We can meet both.

Recommended internal approach:
1) Offer a 6-week pilot scoped to $40-45k with net-30 invoice terms (PO) to hit the budget owner sign-off.
2) Offer a 10% pilot discount if we want to accelerate buy-in — fine to use from our pilot budget.
3) Prepare a minimal SOW + invoice template to speed procurement (attached).

Can you confirm legal/finance okay with net-30 + 10% pilot discount for Acme? If yes, I'll draft the final SOW and send to procurement.

-- Marissa

Thanks for the context. Net-30 + 10% pilot discount is OK from my side for this account — seems like a low-risk way to prove value and keep approval path below CFO. Laura, please confirm finance/legal sign-off; if not, let's capture the exception now.

Also, on marketplace: I recommend we lead with direct PO for the pilot (faster) and open marketplace onboarding in parallel if they want a longer-term procurement channel. If they ask for AWS Marketplace pricing/rates, we'll coordinate but don't block pilot on listing.

I can review the SOW and provide redlines by EOD if you send the draft.

-Vivek
